SR-B2.ko: 거인 갈비 마디 갑주를 두르자 칼이 튕겨 나감
SR-B2.equip: a massive rib-bone breastplate is strapped on with heavy iron clanks, a test blade strikes it and rebounds with a ringing clang and a shockwave thump

B2-01.ko: 리벳 망치 톡톡 · 작은 몸이 땡 울림
B2-01.atk: a small hand hammer cracks down on a rivet: a quick light tink-tink, a short iron snap as the head flattens, a tiny metallic skitter across the bench
B2-01.def: a thin apron and little plating take the knock: a light dull clank, a small chink of loose rivets falling, a short wobbling ring

B2-02.ko: 톱니 이빨로 갉아 물음 · 작은 태엽 몸이 튕겨 굴러감
B2-02.atk: a clockwork mouse scurries in with a rapid ticking patter, a whirring spring, then a sharp little gear-tooth nibble with a metallic chitter
B2-02.def: its tiny brass body is knocked away: a light tinny clink, a tumbling rattle across stone, its key whirring as it rights itself

B2-05.ko: 풋내기 어깨 밀치기 · 방패로 막고 되받아침
B2-05.atk: a newcomer shoulder-barges with a leather satchel of tools: a scuffed boot step, a canvas whump, a jangle of pliers and nails against the foe
B2-05.def: a thin studded vest takes the hit with a dull thump, then a quick shoulder-and-shield shove back with a solid wooden smack

B2-06.ko: 빈 갑옷이 문처럼 밀침 · 속 빈 철판이 웅 울림
B2-06.atk: an empty suit of armour strides in with hollow clanks and shoves like a slamming door: a heavy steel thud, a grinding of plates
B2-06.def: the blow rings through hollow plate: a deep empty clang echoing inside the helm, joints rattling, a slow creak as it straightens

B2-07.ko: 방패가 몸째 밀침 · 막고 그대로 내리침
B2-07.atk: a walking shield shuffles in on iron feet and rams: a flat broad steel bang, rivets rattling, a scraping push
B2-07.def: the shield takes the blow full-face: a solid ringing clang, then it tips forward and slams down on the attacker with a heavy rim thud

B2-09.ko: 보일러 증기 주먹 · 말랑한 김 빠진 몸통
B2-09.atk: a boiler-powered fist winds up with a rising hiss, then a piston-driven iron punch thuds home with a puff of escaping steam and a creaking wheeze
B2-09.def: no real guard, its tin belly dents: a hollow boiler boom, a sputtering leak of steam, a weary sighing hiss as pressure bleeds away

B2-12.ko: 모루 망치질 · 굳은살 몸이 퉁 울림
B2-12.atk: a smith's mallet swings in steady pace: a wooden handle creak, a solid hammer strike on glowing iron, a bright anvil ring with sparks hissing
B2-12.def: a stout leather apron and broad frame take the hit: a heavy muffled thump, a deep low anvil hum, a grunt of chains shifting on a belt

B2-15.ko: 대장간 망치로 내리침 · 꿈쩍 않는 쇳몸
B2-15.atk: a smith brings a heavy forge hammer down on the foe: a sizzling quench hiss, a crushing metallic slam like an anvil strike, a humming ring-out lingering in the steel
B2-15.def: thick forge gloves and heavy smith plating stop the blow: a deep clang, boots locked to the ground without moving an inch, a steady droning resonance, hot sparks fizzling

B2-16.ko: 강철 다리로 찍어 누름 · 겹장갑이 연달아 울림
B2-16.atk: a clockwork spider skitters on eight steel legs, gears ratcheting, then a stabbing double clank as its foreleg spikes drive down
B2-16.def: layered plates take the strike: a staggered run of metallic clanks, gears grinding, legs scraping as it holds its ground

B2-17.ko: 무쇠뿔로 들이받음 · 바위 위에 버티고 섬
B2-17.atk: an iron-horn goat clatters up the rocks, rears with a snort, then a ringing iron crack as its horns slam into the foe
B2-17.def: it plants its hooves on rock: a heavy horn-on-steel clang as it catches the blow, a stubborn bleat, gravel skittering away

B2-18.ko: 증기 콧김 뿜고 돌진 · 청동 몸통이 둔중하게 울림
B2-18.atk: a bronze bull paws the floor, blasts a hissing snort of steam, then charges on thundering bronze hooves into a heavy goring slam
B2-18.def: its bronze body takes the hit: a deep hollow boiler boom, a pressure hiss from the nostrils, hooves grinding to hold

B2-19.ko: 모루 몸통으로 내리찍음 · 맞을 때마다 땡 울림
B2-19.atk: a walking anvil hops and drops its whole weight: a short iron scrape, a heavy plunge, then a bright crushing anvil ring on impact
B2-19.def: a hammer-scarred anvil face takes the blow: a pure bright ring like a forge strike, a long humming tone, not moving an inch

B2-22.ko: 쇠를 씹어 삼킴 · 못 박힌 가죽이 무겁게 받음
B2-22.atk: a bulgasari lumbers in on heavy pads, then bites down: a crunching chew of metal, iron teeth grinding, a satisfied rumbling gulp
B2-22.def: its nail-studded hide takes the hit: a dull iron-on-iron thud, half-swallowed locks and nails rattling, a low grumbling snort

B2-24.ko: 강철 날개 펴고 내리꽂힘 · 빈 뼈대에 바람이 울음
B2-24.atk: a steel gargoyle drops from its ledge with a sheet-metal wing flap, a grating screech, then iron claws raking down with a hard clang
B2-24.def: its hollow girder frame rings: a thin metallic clang, wind moaning low through its ribs, loose rivets ticking

B2-25.ko: 공방 지키는 골렘 · 두껍게 울리는 깊은 방어
B2-25.atk: a dormant golem wakes and slaps down a stone-and-iron palm: dust cracking from its joints, a grinding gear turn, a heavy thud with a deep rumble
B2-25.def: a thick chassis rings deep when struck: a solid dense clang, a long resonant boom echoing inside a hollow chamber, gears settling with a slow click

B2-26.ko: 쇠뿔로 육중하게 돌진 · 철판 가죽이 낮게 울림
B2-26.atk: an ironclad rhino stamps its plated feet, a metal-tinged huff, then a thundering charge that ends in a crushing horn crash
B2-26.def: dark-red iron plates take the blow: a deep resonant clank, a groaning low hum like a strained sinew, a heavy stamp

B2-27.ko: 근위장의 육중한 검격 · 방패와 사슬이 막아냄
B2-27.atk: a gate marshal brings down a broadsword in a measured arc: chain mail jingling, a cold blade whistle, a hard slash across a plated shield edge
B2-27.def: a tower shield and mail take the strike: a booming shield clang, chain links rustling, a sturdy thud of a braced heel against stone

B2-28.ko: 은빛 물결로 덮쳐 짓누름 · 흩어졌다 다시 모임
B2-28.atk: a pool of quicksilver rises with a heavy liquid-metal slosh, a rippling metallic shimmer, then a crashing wave of mercury slaps down
B2-28.def: the strike splashes it apart: a thick metallic splatter, beads pattering on stone, then a sliding ripple as they flow back together

B2-30.ko: 쇠 꼬리로 후려침 · 쇠비늘이 단단히 울림
B2-30.atk: an iron wyvern swoops down on heavy metal wingbeats, a grating screech, then a barbed steel tail whips in with a cracking clang
B2-30.def: iron scales take the blow: a hard rattling clank, a beat of heavy wings regaining height, an angry metallic shriek

B2-32.ko: 걸어다니는 성채 짓누름 · 성벽 같은 묵직한 방어
B2-32.atk: a walking citadel lifts a piston leg with a long hydraulic groan, stone grinding, then a thunderous crushing stomp that shakes the ground
B2-32.def: its battlements take the blow: a massive stone-and-iron thud, chains rattling along the walls, a slow settling rumble

B2-33.ko: 회색 아다만트 검 · 빈 뼈 갑옷으로 받고 방패로 되침
B2-33.atk: an empty suit of grey adamant plate swings a bone-pale heavy sword: a dry cold whoosh, a dense low thunk of impact, a stony ring-out like struck marrow
B2-33.def: adamant plate takes the strike: a dull bone-deep clack echoing in the empty helm, a hard muted ring, then a heavy shield-rim counter-blow thudding back into the attacker

B2-34.ko: 용광로 심장 거상의 주먹 · 하얀 김이 뿜어짐
B2-34.atk: a colossus' furnace heart roars, a huge piston arm swings out on a blast of steam, then a gigantic iron slam echoing through the tunnels
B2-34.def: its huge chassis rings like a bell: a gigantic deep clang, then a long white blast of steam hissing from every vent

B2-35.ko: 대장인의 거대 모루망치 · 장인의 두꺼운 방어
B2-35.atk: a master smith lifts an enormous forge hammer: a chain hoist rattle, a thunderous anvil strike with a pure ringing overtone, a shower of sparks crackling
B2-35.def: a stout beard-braided frame and thick leather-and-iron apron take the hit: a heavy deep thump, a resonant anvil tone, a slow chain-link rustle

B2-36.ko: 청동 주먹 내리침 · 거대한 종처럼 울림
B2-36.atk: a bronze giant takes a ground-shaking step, swings a cast-bronze fist with a heavy whoosh, then a deep bell-toned impact
B2-36.def: its cast bronze body rings like a great temple bell: a long deep tone, a low molten hum inside, not budging

B2-41.ko: 풀린 태엽으로 마구 돌진 · 얇은 몸이 부서지며 튕김
B2-41.atk: an over-wound doll sprints in with frantic rapid ticking and a shrill whining spring whir, then a reckless clattering crash of brass limbs
B2-41.def: its thin casing gives way: a brittle metallic crunch, springs pinging loose, a stuttering spin-down of gears

B2-42.ko: 과열 압착기 눌러 뚫음 · 얇은 철판이 우그러짐
B2-42.atk: a runaway press slams down red hot: a screeching hydraulic whine, a deafening piercing crunch through plate, a hot sizzling hiss of crushed metal
B2-42.def: no real housing, it buckles: a shrill grinding screech, sheet metal folding and popping, steam bursting from a burst pipe

B2-43.ko: 자폭 오토마톤 · 째깍 똑딱 후 폭발
B2-43.atk: a ticking clockwork core races faster as the automaton sprints in, then bursts: a rapid frantic click, a swelling whine, a huge iron-shrapnel boom
B2-43.def: its thin shell shatters at once: a brittle snap of casing, a sprinkling of springs and gears bouncing on stone, a last dying whirr

SP-B2.ko: 철의 심장 박동 · 맨 앞을 막아서는 거대한 종
SP-B2.atk: a deep iron heartbeat thuds like a forge bellows, then a titan hammer fist crashes down: shuddering steam, a world-shaking boom, a lingering resonant bronze ring
SP-B2.def: a glowing iron heart beats within its chest as it steps in front to take the blow: a bell-deep clang, a planted stomp, then a huge shield-shove back with a booming metallic slam

UN-B2.ko: 브론의 첫 골렘 · 고철 모아 붙는 소리
UN-B2.atk: a patchwork golem of salvage swings a mismatched arm: scrapyard clanks, a heavy iron slam, then a clinking rain of scrap parts snapping together
UN-B2.def: a thick scrap chassis rings deep and dented as extra scraps snap on: a hollow gong, bolts ratcheting tight, plates magnetically slotting into place

UN-B2-7.ko: 사슬로 묶인 두 골렘 · 쇠사슬이 팽팽히 당겨짐
UN-B2-7.atk: two golems swing a taut steel chain: a heavy link rattle, a whipping whoosh, a savage crack of chain against iron followed by clanking links swinging
UN-B2-7.def: a chain links two bodies and stiffens: a loud tense link rattle, a pair of staggered deep clangs ringing in unison, a taut groan of metal

EP-B2-1.ko: 가시 몸으로 껴안듯 부딪침 · 앞을 막고 가시가 박힘
EP-B2-1.atk: an iron hedgehog rolls in with a spiky rattle, a snuffling grunt, then a prickly metallic crunch as it slams its spines into the foe
EP-B2-1.def: it curls into a ball in front: a bristling clatter of iron spines, the strike landing with a sharp pained prick and a scrape for the attacker

EP-B2-2.ko: 바위 깨는 분쇄 골렘 · 밀리지 않는 돌쇠 몸
EP-B2-2.atk: a mining golem hoists a rock-crusher pick: a heavy overhead creak, an armour-piercing crack that splits stone, a long splintering crash with tinkling shards
EP-B2-2.def: dense stone-iron plating takes the blow without budging: a deep dull ring, a grinding anchor-like settle into the ground, grit trickling off

EP-B2-3.ko: 성문 거상 · 문짝으로 막고 되받아 내리침
EP-B2-3.atk: a living gate swings its huge door-fist in an arc: a groaning hinge, a vast wooden-and-iron slam, spikes raking, and a boom rolling through the tunnel
EP-B2-3.def: a mighty gate door meets the hit with a gigantic clang, then the whole door swings back in a crushing counter-slam with groaning hinges and a booming impact

PN-B2-C1.ko: 쇠 집게로 콱 집음 · 리벳 등딱지가 어디든 같은 소리
PN-B2-C1.atk: a rivet crab scuttles sideways on clacking legs, raises its tong-like pincers, then a hard metallic snap clamps down
PN-B2-C1.def: its riveted shell takes the blow: the same flat iron knock wherever it is struck, a quick scuttle back, pincers clicking

PN-B2-C2.ko: 땅 파고 들어와 발톱으로 긁음 · 굴 속에 몸을 묻음
PN-B2-C2.atk: a steel mole grinds through the ground with a drilling whirr, bursts out in a spray of gravel, then rakes with a screeching steel-claw scrape
PN-B2-C2.def: it hunches into its burrow: a dull earthy thud, a puff of hot steamy breath, dirt and ore dust trickling down

PN-B2-C3.ko: 망치 팔로 내리침 · 막고 쇠 몸으로 되받음
PN-B2-C3.atk: a hammer-armed colossus lifts a fist with a grinding gear groan, then a crushing forge-hammer slam with a shower of sparks
PN-B2-C3.def: it blocks with a massive hammer arm: a mighty clang, then swings back in a counter-slam with a deep ringing thud

PN-B2-U1.ko: 직접 두드린 방패 · 막고 방패 테두리로 되침
PN-B2-U1.atk: a dwarf bashes with the rim of a hand-forged shield: a short leather strap creak, a crisp forward smack, a ring of beaten metal
PN-B2-U1.def: a battered shield takes the hit with a heavy clonk and a long steady ring, then the rim is driven back into the attacker with a crisp hard smack

PN-B2-U2.ko: 광석 턱으로 물어뜯음 · 꿈쩍 않고 껍질로 되받음
PN-B2-U2.atk: an ore beetle trundles forward with a grinding chitin clack, opens rocky mandibles, then a heavy crunch like a pick splitting stone
PN-B2-U2.def: its ore shell takes the blow unmoved: a dense stone-and-metal clank, then it butts back with a hard shell slam and flying grit

PN-B2-R.ko: 방패 벽이 밀어붙임 · 깊은 쇳소리로 울리며 버팀
PN-B2-R.atk: a shield spirit's plates swing together with a resonant hum, a wall of steel surges forward, then a deep shield-wall clang strikes
PN-B2-R.def: overlapping ghostly plates take the strike: a deep giant-like ring humming through the ground, a shimmer of metal settling back into place

PN-B2-E.ko: 용을 본 거울 골렘 · 앞을 막고 되비쳐 되침
PN-B2-E.atk: a mirrored golem thrusts a polished fist: a glassy metal shimmer, a punch with a rippling chime-like echo, a long scintillating ring
PN-B2-E.def: its mirror-bright body steps in front of the blow: a crystalline metallic chime, a deep immovable clang, then a polished fist snapping back with a ringing counter-punch

UP-B2-12.ko: 단조 명장 · 세 망치가 합쳐진 한 방
UP-B2-12.atk: a master strikes a flawless triple-beat of hammer on anvil: three fast clangs fusing into a single ringing blow, with a white spark sizzle
UP-B2-12.def: a thick leather apron and a forged breastplate take the strike: a deep clean anvil ring, a quiet sizzle of quenching steel, a slow warm hum

UP-B2-17.ko: 산양왕이 바위를 박차 무쇠뿔로 들이받음 · 버티고 서서 뿔로 받음
UP-B2-17.atk: heavy hooves clatter up the rocks, a deep snort, then massive iron horns slam into the foe with a ringing iron crack and a boom
UP-B2-17.def: it plants its hooves on rock: a heavy horn-on-steel clang as it catches the blow, a stubborn deep bleat, gravel skittering away

UP-B2-18.ko: 청동 황소가 증기를 뿜고 돌진해 들이받음 · 보일러 몸이 웅웅
UP-B2-18.atk: a huge bronze bull paws the floor, blasts a roaring snort of steam, then charges on thundering bronze hooves into a heavy goring slam
UP-B2-18.def: its massive bronze hull absorbs the strike: a deep booming boiler resonance, twin jets of hot steam venting fiercely from its nostrils, heavy iron hooves scraping hard to hold ground

UP-B2-22.ko: 불가사리 왕이 쇠를 우두둑 씹어 삼킴 · 못 박힌 가죽이 받음
UP-B2-22.atk: a giant bulgasari lumbers in on heavy pads, then bites down: a crunching chew of iron plate, metal teeth grinding, a deep satisfied rumbling gulp
UP-B2-22.def: its thick nail-studded hide takes the hit: a dull iron-on-iron thud, half-swallowed nails and locks rattling, a low grumbling snort

UP-B2-24.ko: 철골 가고일이 내려와 쇠발톱으로 긁음 · 철골 몸이 울림
UP-B2-24.atk: a big steel gargoyle drops from a gate ledge with a sheet-metal wing flap, a grating screech, then heavy iron claws rake down with a hard clang
UP-B2-24.def: its girder frame rings: a deep metallic clang, wind moaning low through its ribs, loose rivets ticking

RS-B2-4.ko: 방패 벽이 한 몸으로 밀고 나감

IB2-5.equip: a heavy palm-shaped shield is lifted from a rack: a straps-and-buckles rustle, a dense iron clink on the arm, a muffled knock of a fist testing its face

M3-1.equip: a chisel taps a rune into a stone-iron heart: sharp chip-chip engraving, grains of dust, a glowing low hum rising and fixing with a solid thunk

IB2-6.equip: a giant glowing core is lowered into a chassis: a deep grinding turn, a pulsing hum building, locking bolts clanking home with a hiss of steam

IR-B2.equip: a thin plate of grey adamant is slid into place: a pure cool metallic whisper, a clean heavy click of latches, a long muted ring when tapped

PI-B2.equip: a thick metal-sinew cable is wound round a body: a taut creaking pull, wire strands twanging, a deep muscle-like hum as it cinches tight with a ringing lock

TK-B2-1.ko: 작은 파수 골렘 · 철판 자그마한 울림
TK-B2-1.atk: a small sentry golem jabs a stubby iron fist: a quick servo chirp, a sharp compact clank, a brief rattle of its loose plating
TK-B2-1.def: its little plated chassis rings thinly: a bright high clang, a tinny shiver of loose rivets, a quick click of resetting joints

TK-U-SCRAP.atk: a jumble of salvaged parts swings a crooked scrap arm: a rattling clang of tin and pipes, a lumpy thud, bolts tinkling across stone
TK-U-SCRAP.def: its mismatched plating clatters and dents: a hollow pot-metal bong, a clumsy shower of loose scrap, a ratcheting snap as a spare part clips back
